source.title: The Heart of the Void
source.description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
source.objective: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
source.progress: <name>, what news do you have from Blackfathom?
source.completion:
The servant of the Old Gods, Aku'mai, is dead. You have done a mighty service for the denizens of Kalimdor with this deed.

The pearl may also be the key to much greater understanding of the nature of the Void and its effect on our world.  It must be studied at once. Walk with the Earth Mother, <name>.
